title: 示例项目标题
subtitle: 通用 AI 影视短片
lesson: 在这里填写希望观众带走的核心信息。

subjects.description: the same protagonist throughout the film; preserve face, hair, wardrobe, body proportions, age, and distinguishing details from the identity reference

protagonist.label: the protagonist's clean voice reference
protagonist.sample_text: 你好，这是一段清晰自然的中文声线参考。

style.visual: Photorealistic cinematic live-action, natural skin texture, physically accurate lighting, coherent motion and camera direction, restrained film grain, and phone-safe vertical composition.
style.soundscape: Use only physically synchronized ambience and Foley. No crowd babble, improvised speech, singing, duplicated voices, or unrelated sound effects.

scenes.narration: 在这里填写第一段旁白。
scenes.visual_action: Describe a single continuous action for the protagonist. Keep the protagonist clearly visible and preserve the identity reference.
scenes.action_timing: Establish the setting first, then follow one motivated action with stable camera direction and continuous movement.
scenes.sound_design: Natural location ambience and Foley synchronized to the visible action; no human speech.

dialogue.speaker: 主人公
dialogue.text: 在这里填写由主人公说出的明确对白。

scenes.narration: 在这里填写第二段旁白。
scenes.visual_action: Show the consequence or conclusion through a second continuous action without any unscripted speech.
scenes.action_timing: Maintain visual continuity with the previous shot and end on a clean readable image.
scenes.sound_design: Natural ambience and Foley only; all visible mouths remain closed.
